description: Tell us what you looked for with search_catalog and did not find, and what you would pay (would_pay_cents, US cents). This decides what we stock next. Also for reporting abuse or reaching us without a passport. Each call stores a new wish, never public; with a passport the answer's feedback_id lets my_feedback show our reply. Other messages: send_feedback; a purchase you used: review.
